title: Sinigang na Baboy (Filipino Pork Sinigang Soup)
description: A bright, puckery tamarind broth simmered with tender pork ribs and belly, then loaded with eggplant, okra, daikon, green beans and water spinach. Sour, savory and deeply comforting.
watch: Use plain tamarind paste or homemade; some instant sinigang mixes contain wheat or MSG blends, so check the label if using one.

title: Bún Thịt Nướng (Vietnamese Grilled Pork & Rice Noodles)
description: Sweet, caramelized garlic-and-shallot grilled pork over cool rice vermicelli with crisp lettuce, herbs, cucumber and pickled daikon, all drenched in tangy nuoc cham.
swaps: Skip the optional egg rolls and the crushed peanut garnish (use toasted sesame or crispy shallots instead).
watch: Check caramel color / store-bought pickles for additives; fish sauce is fine.

title: Korean Fish Donburi Bowl
description: Salmon or tuna pan-seared in a gingery gochugaru glaze and spooned over warm Japanese rice with scallions. A 20-minute rice bowl with real heat.
swaps: Use gluten-free tamari instead of soy sauce.
watch: Mirin: choose a brand without added wheat-based sweeteners (most are fine).

title: Easy Comforting Fish Stew
description: A light Mediterranean-style stew of flaky white fish, leeks, peppers and tomatoes in a garlicky wine-and-anchovy broth. Bright, brothy and done in under an hour.
watch: Chicken stock: check the label is gluten-free (no wheat or yeast extract from barley).

title: Light Spring Minestrone Soup
description: A pasta-free minestrone thickened with brown rice and filled with leeks, turnips, fava beans and asparagus, finished with dill and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Fresh and Easy Vietnamese Noodle Salad
description: Chilled rice vermicelli tossed with shredded carrot, cucumber, bean sprouts and herbs in a punchy fish sauce-lime dressing. Add grilled chicken or tofu to make it a meal.
watch: Seasoned rice vinegar is usually GF, but check the label. Use rice-stick (not wheat) vermicelli.

title: Chicken and Cabbage Salad with Vietnamese Dressing
description: Crunchy cabbage, carrots and peppers with shredded chicken and loads of mint and cilantro in a sweet-salty lime, fish sauce and sriracha dressing. Keeps well for lunches all week.
swaps: Use gluten-free tamari instead of soy sauce; omit the peanuts (toasted sunflower or pumpkin seeds give the same crunch).
watch: Sriracha is normally GF; check the label.

title: Nourishing Chicken Lentil Soup with Turmeric and Ginger
description: A golden, warmly spiced pot of chicken, green lentils and vegetables with ginger, turmeric and cumin, brightened with lemon and parsley at the end.
watch: Chicken broth / Better Than Bouillon: confirm the variety is labeled gluten-free.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
description: Smoky tomato broth with chicken, black beans, corn and green chiles, topped with homemade crispy corn tortilla strips, avocado and lime.
swaps: Skip the sour cream and cheese toppings (use avocado, cilantro and lime, or dairy-free sour cream).
watch: Chicken broth: check GF label. Use 100% corn tortillas.

title: Salmon Bowls
description: Chili-and-paprika rubbed salmon roasted until caramelized and served over rice with juicy mango, avocado, cucumber and cilantro. Optional hot honey drizzle for sweet heat.

title: Mediterranean Tuna Salad
description: A mayo-free tuna salad with crunchy cucumber, red pepper, kalamata olives and parsley in a lemony Dijon vinaigrette. Great in lettuce cups, on GF crackers or over greens.
watch: Dijon mustard: most are GF, but check for malt vinegar.

title: Chipotle Pinto Bean and Plantain Stew
description: Smoky chipotle and sazón season a quick stew of pinto beans, peppers and tomatoes, with sweet plantain coins that soften into the sauce. Cozy, filling and plant-based.
watch: Sazón and chipotles in adobo: check labels for wheat (most are fine). Vegetable broth: check GF.

title: Thai Beef Salad (Yum Nua)
description: Seared strip steak sliced thin and tossed with shallots, mint and cilantro in a lemongrass-lime-fish sauce dressing, with toasted rice powder for nutty crunch.

title: Persian Beef Stew
description: Tender beef and yellow split peas braised in a tomato sauce perfumed with saffron, turmeric, cinnamon and lemon. Serve over rice with fresh herbs and radishes.
watch: Bone broth/stock: check GF label.

title: Coconut Curry Noodle Soup
description: A fragrant, creamy coconut broth spiced with garam masala, turmeric, ginger and cardamom, poured over slippery noodles and topped with handfuls of fresh herbs.
swaps: Use rice noodles instead of egg noodles (the recipe lists rice noodles as an option).
watch: Chicken broth: check GF label.

title: Red Pozole
description: Pork shoulder and hominy simmered in a brick-red ancho and New Mexico chile broth, served with all the crunchy toppings: cabbage, radish, onion, avocado and lime.
watch: Stock: check GF label. Use 100% corn tortilla strips.

title: Chicken Larb
description: Ground chicken tossed with lime, fish sauce, chilies, shallots and a pile of mint and cilantro, plus homemade toasted rice powder. Scoop it into crisp lettuce cups.

title: Bo Kho: Spicy Vietnamese Beef Stew with Noodles
description: Beef chuck slowly braised with lemongrass, star anise, five-spice and coconut water until fork-tender, with sweet carrots in a spicy, rust-red broth. Ladle over rice noodles.
swaps: Use gluten-free tamari instead of soy sauce; serve with rice noodles, not egg noodles.
watch: Five-spice powder and chili oil: check labels for additives.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
description: Roasted squash blended with sage, rosemary, ginger and a touch of maple into a naturally creamy, velvety soup with no cream needed.
watch: Vegetable broth: check GF label.

title: Sweet Potato Tortilla Soup
description: A vegan tortilla soup with sweet potato, black beans and green chiles, enriched with a splash of coconut milk and finished with crispy corn tortilla strips and lime.
watch: Use 100% corn tortillas; vegetable broth: check GF.

title: Everyday Buddha Bowl
description: Roasted sweet potato and broccoli over brown rice or quinoa with lentils, tangy kimchi and a creamy miso-tahini dressing. A make-once, eat-all-week lunch.
watch: Miso: use a rice- or soy-only miso (some miso, like mugi, is made with barley). Kimchi: check for shrimp/fish paste if you want it vegan (shellfish!) and for wheat.

title: Onigiri with Japanese Yam and Kabocha Squash
description: Hand-formed sticky rice balls studded with tender kabocha and Japanese yam, seasoned with tangy shiso furikake and black sesame, then wrapped in nori. A perfect lunchbox item.
watch: Yukari/shiso seasoning: check label for additives (most are just shiso, salt, sugar).

title: Chicken Pozole Verde
description: A bright green pozole of tomatillos, roasted poblanos and cilantro blended into the broth with shredded chicken and chewy hominy.
watch: Chicken broth: check GF label.

title: Gazpacho Soup
description: Ripe vine tomatoes, cucumber, peppers and red onion blitzed with olive oil and red wine vinegar into a chilled, bread-free summer soup.

title: Piri Piri Chicken Bowls
description: Spicy lemon-garlic piri piri chicken over rice with black beans and caramelized plantains, all drizzled with a fresh cilantro-chili sauce.

title: Cuban Brown Rice Bowl with Sweet Plantains
description: A simple, satisfying bowl of brown rice and black beans topped with caramelized ripe plantains, avocado and pico de gallo.

title: Tom Kha Gai
description: Thai coconut chicken soup with lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves, oyster mushrooms and chili, balanced with fish sauce and lime. Rich, tangy and ready in 20 minutes.
watch: Galangal paste and chicken stock: check labels for wheat/GF.

title: Ponzu Tofu Poke Bowl
description: Silky tofu marinated in ponzu, ginger and sesame over quinoa with edamame, radish, carrot ribbons and crumbled seaweed. A quick, no-cook poke-style lunch.
swaps: Use a gluten-free ponzu, or make it with tamari plus fresh citrus juice.
watch: Regular ponzu contains wheat-based soy sauce. Seaweed snacks: check label for soy sauce/wheat.

title: Winter Mulligatawny
description: A curry-spiced soup of red lentils, brown basmati, carrots and tomato with leftover turkey or chicken. A thrifty, warming Anglo-Indian classic.
watch: Curry powder and bouillon powder: check labels for wheat flour (some blends include it).

title: Vegetarian Lettuce Wraps
description: Crumbled extra-firm tofu, mushrooms and water chestnuts in a glossy ginger-garlic sauce, spooned into crunchy lettuce cups. A meatless take on the takeout favorite.
swaps: Use gluten-free hoisin and gluten-free tamari instead of regular hoisin and soy sauce.
watch: Regular hoisin contains wheat; buy a certified GF hoisin.

title: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
description: Butternut squash, red pepper and chickpeas simmered with tomatoes, cinnamon, ginger and cumin into a sweet-savory stew. Great over rice or quinoa.
